The '''mother''' of [[Calo Nord]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Calo Nord's father|Nord's father]]. The couple sold their son into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] when he was a young boy. When he turned sixteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of age, Nord [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Slavery/Legends|slave masters]] and proceeded to track down and murder his parents. After Nord killed his parents, a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on his head. However, Nord killed the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] sent after him, and eventually found and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the people who placed that bounty. He grew to become the most feared bounty hunter of his time.<ref name="TCSWE" />
